verses.1: Because the Meqabyan found the Jews in Mesopotamia of Syria, he killed them with the sword, from their border as far as the region of Jerusalem, from Jabok and from the ascent of the holy mountain.
verses.2: For they had come up from Samaria as far as the region of Jerusalem and all its surroundings, and they killed with the edge of the sword until none were left except fugitives; for the Edomites, the Syrians, and the Amalekites had joined together with the Moabite Meqabyan, who destroyed the city of Jerusalem.
verses.3: And when the children of Israel were afflicted, the Moabite Meqabyan sent against them and killed them all with slaughter.
verses.4: And because of this thing the wrath of God went forth against his holy city, and they were scattered in their days.
verses.5: And the Edomites and the Elophlites rose up and began to curse the city of God, for He Himself had sent them because they had despised the word of God.
verses.6: And this Meqabyan, whose city was Remath of Moab, arose in power from his city and was scattered together with those who were with him.
verses.7: And the armies of Gelabuhe of Mesopotamia as far as Syria conspired to destroy the city of God; and from there he asked the Elophlites and the Amalekites, and he gave them much gold and silver, horses and chariots, so that they might be with him in the day of battle.
verses.8: And they came together and surrounded the city, and they poured out its blood like water upon those who dwelt in it.
verses.9: And they left Jerusalem like a hut of a keeper of grain, and they made in it dung and refuse and everything that God does not approve; they made the city of God, which was full of righteousness and holiness, a place of filth and defilement.
verses.10: And they left their carcasses as food for the birds of the heaven, and the flesh of Your righteous ones for the beasts of the wilderness.
verses.11: And they slaughtered the young men and the children, and they ripped open the pregnant women and brought forth what was in their wombs, until God, who tests the heart and the reins, was provoked; for without the fear of God they acted as Satan had taught them.
verses.12: And they returned to their habitations, rejoicing over the evil they had done against the people of God; and they carried away the captives and the plunder which they had plundered from the holy city.
verses.13: And when they entered and went into their dwellings, they made joy and gladness and feasting.
